content:
I tried to tune the score function so that the puzzle is interesting both as an online optimization game and as an offline one. In particular:

- I tried to make algorithmic and heuristic insight matter more than computational resources.
- I tried to make it extremely hard to reach the global optimum.
- I tried to build strategic trade-offs into the scoring so that local optima arise easily.
- I made sure the total score fits within a 53-bit integer.

If you have any better ideas, please feel free to suggest them. \(^_^)/
